False Flag Operations.description: At the start of your turn, you may exhaust this card and 1 planet you control to ready 1 non-home planet other than Mecatol Rex.
False Flag Operations.name: False Flag Operations

Geosympathic Impeller.description: After you activate a system, you may exhaust a planet you control of the same type as a planet in that system to apply +1 to the move value of each of your ships during this tactical action.
Geosympathic Impeller.name: Geosympathic Impeller

Contractual Obligations.description: At the start of the agenda phase, for each unit upgrade technology you control, you may choose 1 player. Each of those players must produce 1 ship in a system that contains 1 or more of their space docks or war suns.
Contractual Obligations.name: Contractual Obligations

Terrafactory II.description:
Other player's units in this system lose PLANETARY SHIELD.

This unit produces only 1 fighter or infantry for their cost instead of 2.
Terrafactory II.name: Terrafactory II

Unholy Abomination II.description: After this unit is destroyed, roll 1 die. If the result is 6 or greater, place the unit on this card. At the start of your turn, place each unit that is on this card on a planet you control, if able.
Unholy Abomination II.name: Unholy Abomination II

Recursive Worm.description: At the start of your turn, you may exhaust this card to choose 1 non-home system other than Mecatol Rex that contains 1 or more of your units; place 1 other player's command token from their reinforcements in that system.
Recursive Worm.name: Recursive Worm

Stone's Embrace.description: When you would spend a token from your strategy pool, you may exhaust 1 planet you control to spend 1 token from your reinforcements instead.
Stone's Embrace.name: Stone's Embrace

Gauss Cannon II.description:
This unit is placed in a space area instead of on a planet. This unit can move and retreat as if it were a ship.

This unit can be blockaded, if it is blockaded, it is destroyed.
Gauss Cannon II.name: Gauss Cannon II

Orbital Defense Grid.description:
At the start of invasion, choose up to 1 unit you control in the active system; that unit gains PLANETARY SHIELD.

When a player commits a unit to land on a planet you control, you may exhaust this card to destroy that unit.
Orbital Defense Grid.name: Orbital Defense Grid

Emergency Deployment.description: ACTION: Exhaust this card to place or move 1 of your space docks onto a planet you control.
Emergency Deployment.name: Emergency Deployment

Rift Engines.description: After you activate a system, you may exhaust this card to choose 1 ship you control and roll a die. On a result of 1-3, remove that ship from the game board; on a result of 4-10, apply +2 to that ship's move value during this tactical action.
Rift Engines.name: Rift Engines

Blockade Runner II.description: This ship can move through systems that contain other players' ships.
Blockade Runner II.name: Blockade Runner II

Daedalon Flight System.description: After a round of space combat in a system that contains 1 or more of your mechs, you may have 1 of those units become damaged to produce 1 hit and assign it to a cruiser, dreadnought, or destroyer you do not control in that system.
Daedalon Flight System.name: Daedalon Flight System

Midas Turbine.description: After you activate a system, you may exhaust this card and spend any number of trade goods; for each trade good you spent, apply +1 to the move value of 1 non-fighter ship you control.
Midas Turbine.name: Midas Turbine

Krovoz Strike Teams.description:
After another player's unit uses SUSTAIN DAMAGE to cancel a hit produced by your units or abilities, you may exhaust this card to destroy that unit.

After you produce 1 or more hits during a round of combat, you may spend 1 trade good to produce 1 additional hit.
Krovoz Strike Teams.name: Krovoz Strike Teams

Scavenger Exos.description: Once per action, after you win a ground combat, you may draw 1 action card.
Scavenger Exos.name: Scavenger Exos

Raider II.description: During a round of space combat, if your opponent cannot declare a retreat, hits produced by this ship cannot be canceled and must be assigned to non-fighter ships, if able.
Raider II.name: Raider II

Lancer Dreadnought II.description: This unit cannot be destroyed by "Direct Hit" action cards.
Lancer Dreadnought II.name: Lancer Dreadnought II

SEIDR Project.description: At the end of each round of space combat, you may use the SPACE CANNON of 1 of your units in the active system against your opponent's ships, without rolling additional dice.
SEIDR Project.name: SEIDR Project

Sanctification Field.description: When you activate a system, or a system that contains 1 or more of your units is activated, you may choose 1 technology or non-fighter, non-structure unit upgrade technology another player controls; until the end of this tactical action, that card is treated as though it had no ability text.
Sanctification Field.name: Sanctification Field

Pilgrimage Beacons.description: Once during your turn, when you exhaust 1 or more planets you control that have a technology specialty, you may produce 1 ship in 1 system that contains 1 of those planets.
Pilgrimage Beacons.name: Pilgrimage Beacons

Shard Volley.description: When 1 or more of your units produce 1 or more hits during a BOMBARDMENT roll against a planet, produce 1 additional hit for that roll.
Shard Volley.name: Shard Volley

Impactor II.description: After this unit is destroyed, roll 1 die. If the result is 6 or greater, place the unit on this card. At the start of your next turn, place each unit that is on this card on a planet you control in your home system.
Impactor II.name: Impactor II

Emelpar.ability: You may exhaust this card at the end of your turn to ready another component that isn't a strategy card.
Emelpar.name: Emelpar

Industrex.ability: You may exhaust this card when you pass to place 1 ship that matches a unit upgrade technology you own from your reinforcements into a system that contains your ships.
Industrex.name: Industrex

Dominus Orb.description: Before you move units during a tactical action, you may purge this card to move and transport units that are in systems that contain 1 of your command tokens.
Dominus Orb.name: Dominus Orb

Maw of Worlds.description: At the start of the agenda phase, you may purge this card and exhaust all of your planets to gain any 1 technology.
Maw of Worlds.name: Maw of Worlds

Scepter of Emelpar.description: When you would spend a token from your strategy pool, you may exhaust this card to spend a token from your reinforcements instead.
Scepter of Emelpar.name: Scepter of Emelpar

Shard of the Throne.description:
When you gain this card, gain 1 victory point. When you lose this card, lose 1 victory point.

When a player gains control of a legendary planet you control, or a planet you control in your home system, that player gains this card.
Shard of the Throne.name: Shard of the Throne

Stellar Converter.description: ACTION: Choose 1 non-home, non-legendary planet other than Mecatol Rex in a system that is adjacent to 1 or more of your units that have BOMBARDMENT; destroy all units on that planet and purge its attachments and its planet card. Then, place the destroyed planet token on that planet and purge this card.
Stellar Converter.name: Stellar Converter

The Codex.description: ACTION: Purge this card to take up to 3 action cards of your choice from the action card discard pile.
The Codex.name: The Codex

The Crown of Emphidia.description:
After you perform a tactical action, you may exhaust this card to explore 1 planet you control.

At the end of the status phase, if you control the "Tomb of Emphidia", you may purge this card to gain 1 Victory Point.
The Crown of Emphidia.name: The Crown of Emphidia

The Crown of Thalnos.description: During each combat round, this card's owner may reroll any number of their dice, applying +1 to the results; any units that reroll dice but do not produce at least 1 hit are destroyed.
The Crown of Thalnos.name: The Crown of Thalnos

The Obsidian.description: When you gain this card, draw 1 secret objective. You can have 1 additional scored or unscored secret objective.
The Obsidian.name: The Obsidian

The Prophet's Tears.description: When you research a technology, you may exhaust this card to ignore 1 prerequisite or draw 1 action card.
The Prophet's Tears.name: The Prophet's Tears

Dynamis Core.description:
While this card is in your play area, your commodity value is increased by 2.

ACTION: Gain trade goods equal to your commodity value, then purge this card.
Dynamis Core.name: Dynamis Core

JR-XS455-O.description: ACTION: Exhaust this agent and choose a player; that player may spend 3 resources to place a structure on a planet they control. If they do not, they gain 1 trade good.
JR-XS455-O.name: JR-XS455-O

Nano-Forge.description: ACTION: Attach this card to a non-legendary, non-home planet you control; its resource and influence values are increased by 2 and it is a legendary planet. This action cannot be performed once attached.
Nano-Forge.name: Nano-Forge

Circlet of the Void.description:
Your units do not roll for gravity rifts, and you ignore the movement effects of other anomalies.

ACTION: Exhaust this card to explore a frontier token in a system that does not contain any other players' ships.
Circlet of the Void.name: Circlet of the Void

Book of Latvinia.description:
When you gain this card, research up to 2 technologies that have no prerequisites.

ACTION: Purge this card; if you control planets that have all 4 types of technology specialties, gain 1 victory point. Otherwise, gain the speaker token.
Book of Latvinia.name: Book of Latvinia

Neuraloop.description: When a public objective is revealed, you may purge one of your relics to discard that objective and replace it with a random objective from any objective deck; that objective is a public objective, even if it is a secret objective.
Neuraloop.name: Neuraloop

Heart of Ixth.description: After any die is rolled, you may exhaust this card to add or subtract 1 from its result.
Heart of Ixth.name: Heart of Ixth

Lightrail Ordnance.description: Your space docks gain SPACE CANNON 5 (x2). You may use your space dock's SPACE CANNON against ships that are adjacent to their systems.
Lightrail Ordnance.name: Lightrail Ordnance

Metali Void Armaments.description: During the "Anti-Fighter Barrage" step of space combat, you may resolve ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE 6 (x3) against your opponent's units.
Metali Void Armaments.name: Metali Void Armaments

Metali Void Shielding.description: Each time hits are produced against 1 or more of your non-fighter ships, 1 of those ships may use SUSTAIN DAMAGE as if it had that ability.
Metali Void Shielding.name: Metali Void Shielding

The Quantumcore.description:
When you gain this card, gain your breakthrough.

You have SYNERGY for all technology types.
The Quantumcore.name: The Quantumcore

The Silver Flame.description:
The Silver Flame may be exchanged as part of a transaction.

ACTION: Roll 1 die and purge this card; if the result is a 10, gain 1 victory point. Otherwise, purge your home system and all units in it; you cannot score public objectives. Put The Fracture into play if it is not already.
The Silver Flame.name: The Silver Flame

The Triad.description: This card can be readied and spent as if it were a planet card. Its resource and influence values are equal to 3 plus the number of different types of relic fragments you own.
The Triad.name: The Triad

Accretion Engine.description: Apply +1 to the PRODUCTION value of each of your units with PRODUCTION. When you produce 1 or more units, reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 1.
Accretion Engine.name: Accretion Engine

Azdel's Key.description: ACTION: Purge this card to draw 3 system tiles with a blue-colored back at random; place 1 of those tiles at the edge of the game board, adjacent to at least 2 other systems. Purge the rest.
Azdel's Key.name: Azdel's Key

E6-G0 Network.description:
You may have 2 additional action cards in your hand, game effects cannot prevent you from using this ability.

At any time, you may exhaust this card to draw 1 action card.
E6-G0 Network.name: E6-G0 Network

Eye of Vogul.description:
After you activate a system:

Purge this card to treat 2 of your ships as adjacent to the active system until the end of this tactical action.
Eye of Vogul.name: Eye of Vogul

Starfall Array.description: When 1 or more of your units roll dice for a unit ability, you may apply +1 to the result of each of those dice, and 1 of those units may roll 1 additional die.
Starfall Array.name: Starfall Array

Forgotten Throne.description: ACTION: Purge this card to either gain 1 relic or immediately score 1 scored secret objective, or 1 of your unscored secret objectives, if you fulfill its requirements.
Forgotten Throne.name: Forgotten Throne

Twilight Mirror.description: At the start of the agenda phase, you may purge this card to resolve 1 non-strategic action.
Twilight Mirror.name: Twilight Mirror

Anti-Intellectual Revolution.description:
For: After a player researches a technology, they must destroy 1 of their non-fighter ships.

Against: At the start of the next strategy phase, each player chooses and exhausts 1 planet for each technology they own.
Anti-Intellectual Revolution.name: Anti-Intellectual Revolution

Arms Reduction.description:
For: Each player destroys all but 2 of their dreadnaughts and all but 4 of their cruisers.

Against: At the start of the next strategy phase, each player exhausts each of their planets that have a technology specialty.
Arms Reduction.name: Arms Reduction

Clandestine Operations.description:
For: Each player removes 2 command tokens from their command sheet and returns those tokens to their reinforcements.

Against: Each player removes 1 command token from their fleet pool and returns that token to their reinforcements.
Clandestine Operations.name: Clandestine Operations

Classified Document Leaks.description:
When this agenda is revealed, if there are no scored secret objectives, discard this card and reveal another agenda from the top of the deck.

The elected secret objective becomes a public objective; place it near the other public objectives in the common play area.
Classified Document Leaks.name: Classified Document Leaks

Colonial Redistribution.description:
Destroy each unit on the elected planet.

Then, the player who controls that planet chooses 1 player with the fewest victory points; that player may place 1 infantry from their reinforcements on the elected planet.
Colonial Redistribution.elect: Non-Home Planet Other Than Mecatol Rex
Colonial Redistribution.name: Colonial Redistribution

Committee Formation.description:
The elected player gains this card.

Before players vote on an agenda that requires a player to be elected, the owner of this card may discard this card to choose a player to be elected. Players do not vote on that agenda.
Committee Formation.name: Committee Formation

Compensated Disarmament.description: Destroy each ground force on the elected planet; for each unit that was destroyed, the player who controls that planet gains 1 trade good.
Compensated Disarmament.name: Compensated Disarmament

Conventions of War.description:
For: Players cannot use BOMBARDMENT against units that are on cultural planets.

Against: Each player that voted "Against" discards all of their action cards.
Conventions of War.name: Conventions of War

Core Mining.description:
Attach this card to the elected planet's card.

Then, destroy 1 infantry on the planet.

The resource value of this planet is increased by 2.
Core Mining.name: Core Mining

Demilitarized Zone.description:
Attach this card to the elected planet's card.

Then, destroy all units on that planet.

Player's units cannot land, be produced, or be placed on this planet.
Demilitarized Zone.name: Demilitarized Zone

Economic Equality.description:
For: Each player returns all of their trade goods to the supply. Then, each player gains 5 trade goods.

Against: Each player returns all of their trade goods to the supply.
Economic Equality.name: Economic Equality

Enforced Travel Ban.description:
For: Alpha and beta wormholes have no effect during movement.

Against: Destroy each PDS in or adjacent to a system that contains a wormhole.
Enforced Travel Ban.name: Enforced Travel Ban

Executive Sanctions.description:
For: Each player can have a maximum of 3 action cards in their hand.

Against: Each player discards 1 random action card from their hand.
Executive Sanctions.name: Executive Sanctions

Fleet Regulations.description:
For: Each player cannot have more than 4 tokens in their fleet pool.

Against: Each player places 1 command token from their reinforcements in their fleet pool.
Fleet Regulations.name: Fleet Regulations

Holy Planet of Ixth.description:
Attach this card to the elected planet's card.

The planet's owner gains 1 victory point.

Units on this planet cannot use PRODUCTION.

When a player gains control of this planet, they gain 1 victory point.

When a player loses control of this planet, they lose 1 victory point.
Holy Planet of Ixth.name: Holy Planet of Ixth

Homeland Defense Act.description:
For: Each player can have any number of PDS units on planets they control.

Against: Each player destroys 1 of their PDS units.
Homeland Defense Act.name: Homeland Defense Act

Imperial Arbiter.description:
The elected player gains this card.

At the end of the strategy phase, the owner of this card may discard this card to swap 1 of their strategy cards with 1 of another player's strategy cards.
Imperial Arbiter.name: Imperial Arbiter

Incentive Program.description:
For: Draw and reveal 1 stage I public objective from the deck and place it near the public objectives.

Against: Draw and reveal 1 stage II public objective from the deck and place it near the public objectives.
Incentive Program.name: Incentive Program

Ixthian Artifact.description:
For: The speaker rolls 1 die. If the result is 6-10, each player may research 2 technologies. If the result is 1-5, destroy all units in Mecatol Rex's system, and each player with units in systems adjacent to Mecatol Rex's system destroys 3 of their units in each of those systems.

Against: No effect.
Ixthian Artifact.name: Ixthian Artifact

Judicial Abolishment.description:
When this agenda is revealed, if there are no laws in play, discard this card and reveal another agenda from the top of the deck.

Discard the elected law from play.
Judicial Abolishment.name: Judicial Abolishment

Minister of Commerce.description:
The elected player gains this card.

After the owner of this card replenishes commodities, they gain 1 trade good for each player that is their neighbor.
Minister of Commerce.name: Minister of Commerce

Minister of Exploration.description:
The elected player gains this card.

When the owner of this card gains control of a planet, they gain 1 trade good.
Minister of Exploration.name: Minister of Exploration

Minister of Industry.description:
The elected player gains this card.

When the owner of this card places a space dock in a system, their units in that system may use their PRODUCTION abilities.
Minister of Industry.name: Minister of Industry

Minister of Peace.description:
The elected player gains this card.

After a player activates a system that contains 1 or more of a different player's units, the owner of this card may discard this card; immediately end the active player's turn.
Minister of Peace.name: Minister of Peace

Minister of Policy.description:
The elected player gains this card.

At the end of the status phase, the owner of this card draws 1 action card.
Minister of Policy.name: Minister of Policy

Minister of Sciences.description:
The elected player gains this card.

When the owner of this card resolves the primary or secondary ability of the "Technology" strategy card, they do not need to spend resources to research technology.
Minister of Sciences.name: Minister of Sciences

Minister of War.description:
The elected player gains this card.

The owner of this card may discard this card after performing an action to remove 1 of their command counters from the game board and return it to their reinforcements; then they may perform 1 additional action.
Minister of War.name: Minister of War

Miscount Disclosed.description:
When this agenda is revealed, if there are no laws in play, discard this card and reveal another agenda from the top of the deck.

Vote on the elected law as if it were just revealed from the top of the deck.
Miscount Disclosed.name: Miscount Disclosed

Mutiny.description:
For: Each player who voted "For" gains 1 victory point.

Against: Each player who voted "For" loses 1 victory point.
Mutiny.name: Mutiny

New Constitution.description:
When this agenda is revealed, if there are no laws in play, discard this card and reveal another agenda from the top of the deck.

For: Discard all laws in play. At the start of the next strategy phase, each player exhausts each planet in their home system.

Against: No effect.
New Constitution.name: New Constitution

Prophecy of Ixth.description:
The elected player gains this card.

The owner of this card applies +1 to the result of their fighter's combat rolls. When the owner of this card uses PRODUCTION, they discard this card unless they produce 2 or more fighters.
Prophecy of Ixth.name: Prophecy of Ixth

Public Execution.description: The elected player discards all of their action cards. If they have the speaker token, they give it to the player on their left. The elected player cannot vote on any agendas during this agenda phase.
Public Execution.name: Public Execution

Publicize Weapon Schematics.description:
For: If any player owns a war sun technology, all players may ignore all prerequisites on war sun technologies. All war suns lose SUSTAIN DAMAGE.

Against: Each player that owns a war sun technology discards all of their action cards.
Publicize Weapon Schematics.name: Publicize Weapon Schematics

Regulated Conscription.description:
For: When a player produces units, they produce only 1 fighter and infantry for its cost instead of 2.

Against: No effect.
Regulated Conscription.name: Regulated Conscription

Representative Government.description:
For: Players cannot exhaust planets to cast votes during the agenda phase. Each player may cast 1 vote on each agenda instead.

Against: At the start of the next strategy phase, each player that voted "Against" exhausts all of their cultural planets.
Representative Government.name: Representative Government

omegas.description:
For: Players cannot exhaust planets to cast votes during the agenda phase; each player may cast 1 vote on each agenda instead. Players cannot cast additional votes.

Against: At the start of the next strategy phase, each player that voted "Against" exhausts all of their cultural planets.

Research Team: Biotic.description:
Attach this card to the elected planet's card.

When the owner of this planet researches technology, they may exhaust this card to ignore 1 green prerequisite.
Research Team: Biotic.name: Research Team: Biotic

Research Team: Cybernetic.description:
Attach this card to the elected planet's card.

When the owner of this planet researches technology, they may exhaust this card to ignore 1 yellow prerequisite.
Research Team: Cybernetic.name: Research Team: Cybernetic

Research Team: Propulsion.description:
Attach this card to the elected planet's card.

When the owner of this planet researches technology, they may exhaust this card to ignore 1 blue prerequisite.
Research Team: Propulsion.name: Research Team: Propulsion

Research Team: Warfare.description:
Attach this card to the elected planet's card.

When the owner of this planet researches technology, they may exhaust this card to ignore 1 red prerequisite.
Research Team: Warfare.name: Research Team: Warfare

Seed of an Empire.description:
For: The player with most victory points gains 1 victory point.

Against: The player with the fewest victory points gains 1 victory point.
Seed of an Empire.name: Seed of an Empire

Senate Sanctuary.description:
Attach this card to the elected planet's card.

The influence value of this planet is increased by 2.
Senate Sanctuary.name: Senate Sanctuary

Shard of the Throne.description:
The elected player gains this card.

A player gains this card and 1 victory point when they win a combat against the owner of this card.

Then, the previous owner of this card loses 1 victory point.
Shard of the Throne.name: Shard of the Throne

Shared Research.description:
For: Each player's units can move through nebulae.

Against: Each player places a command token from their reinforcements in their home system, if able.
Shared Research.name: Shared Research

Swords to Plowshares.description:
For: Each player destroys half of their infantry on each planet they control, rounded up. Then, each player gains trade goods equal to the number of their infantry that were destroyed.

Against: Each player places 1 infantry from their reinforcements on each planet they control.
Swords to Plowshares.name: Swords to Plowshares

Terraforming Initiative.description:
Attach this card to the elected planet's card.

The resource and influence values of this planet are increased by 1.
Terraforming Initiative.name: Terraforming Initiative

The Crown of Emphidia.description:
The elected player gains this card.

A player gains this card and 1 victory point after they gain control of a planet in the home system of this card's owner.

Then, the previous owner of this card loses 1 victory point.
The Crown of Emphidia.name: The Crown of Emphidia

The Crown of Thalnos.description:
The elected player gains this card.

During each combat round, the owner of this card may reroll any number of dice; they must destroy each of their units that did not produce a hit with its reroll.
The Crown of Thalnos.name: The Crown of Thalnos

Unconventional Measures.description:
For: Each player that voted "For" draws 2 action cards.

Against: Each player that voted "For" discards all of their action cards.
Unconventional Measures.name: Unconventional Measures

Wormhole Reconstruction.description:
For: All systems that contain either an alpha or beta wormhole are adjacent to each other.

Against: Each player places a command token from their reinforcements in each system that contains a wormhole and 1 or more of their ships.
Wormhole Reconstruction.name: Wormhole Reconstruction

Wormhole Research.description:
For: Each player who has 1 or more ships in a system that contains a wormhole may research 1 technology. Then, destroy all ships in systems that contain an alpha or beta wormhole.

Against: Each player that voted "Against" removes 1 command token from their command sheet and returns it to their reinforcements.
Wormhole Research.name: Wormhole Research

Armed Forces Standardization.description: The elected player places command tokens from their reinforcements so that they have 3 tokens in their tactic pool, 3 tokens in their fleet pool and 2 tokens in their strategy pool. They return any excess tokens to their reinforcements.
Armed Forces Standardization.name: Armed Forces Standardization

Articles of War.description:
FOR : All mechs lose their printed abilities except for SUSTAIN DAMAGE.

AGAINST : Each player that voted "For" gains 3 trade goods.
Articles of War.name: Articles of War

Checks and Balances.description:
FOR : When a player chooses a strategy card during the strategy phase, they give that strategy card to another player that does not have 1 (or a player that does not have 2 in a three- or four-player game), if able.

AGAINST : Each player readies only 3 of their planets at the end of this agenda phase.
Checks and Balances.name: Checks and Balances

Covert Legislation.description:
When this agenda is revealed, the speaker draws the next card in the agenda deck but does not reveal it to the other players.

Instead, the speaker reads the eligible outcomes aloud (For, Against, Elect Player, etc.); the other players vote for these outcomes as if they were outcomes of this agenda, without knowing their effects.
Covert Legislation.name: Covert Legislation

Galactic Crisis Pact.description: Each player may perform the secondary ability of the elected strategy card without spending a command token; command tokens placed by the ability are placed from a player's reinforcements instead.
Galactic Crisis Pact.name: Galactic Crisis Pact

Nexus Sovereignty.description:
FOR : Alpha and beta wormholes in the wormhole nexus have no effect during movement.

AGAINST : Place a gamma wormhole token in the Mecatol Rex system.
Nexus Sovereignty.name: Nexus Sovereignty

Political Censure.description:
The elected player gains this card and 1 victory point.

The elected player cannot play action cards.

If the owner of this card loses this card, they lose 1 victory point.
Political Censure.name: Political Censure

Rearmament Agreement.description:
FOR : Each player places 1 mech from their reinforcements on a planet they control in their home system.

AGAINST : Each player replaces each of their mechs with 1 infantry from their reinforcements.
Rearmament Agreement.name: Rearmament Agreement

Research Grant Reallocation.description: The elected player gains any 1 technology of their choice. Then, for each prerequisite on that technology, they remove 1 token from their fleet pool and return it to their reinforcements.
Research Grant Reallocation.name: Research Grant Reallocation

Search Warrant.description:
The elected player gains this card and draws 2 secret objectives.

The owner of this card plays with their secret objectives revealed.
Search Warrant.name: Search Warrant

Ancient Burial Sites.description:
At the start of the agenda phase:

Choose 1 player. Exhause each cultural planet owned by that player.
Ancient Burial Sites.name: Ancient Burial Sites

Assassinate Representative.description:
After an agenda is revealed:

Choose 1 player. That player cannot vote on this agenda.
Assassinate Representative.name: Assassinate Representative

Bribery.description:
After the speaker votes on an agenda:

Spend any number of trade goods. For each trade good spent, cast 1 additional vote for the outcome on which you voted.
Bribery.name: Bribery

Bunker.description:
At the start of an invasion:

During this invasion, apply -4 to the result of each BOMBARDMENT roll against planets you control.
Bunker.name: Bunker

Confusing Legal Text.description:
When you are elected as the outcome of an agenda:

Choose 1 player. That player is the elected player instead.
Confusing Legal Text.name: Confusing Legal Text

Construction Rider.description:
After an agenda is revealed:

You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, place 1 space dock from your reinforcements on a planet you control.
Construction Rider.name: Construction Rider

Courageous to the End.description:
After 1 of your ships is destroyed during a space combat:

Roll 2 dice. For each result equal to or greater than that ship's combat value, your opponent must choose and destroy 1 of their ships.
Courageous to the End.name: Courageous to the End

Cripple Defenses.description: ACTION: Choose 1 planet. Destroy each PDS on that planet.
Cripple Defenses.name: Cripple Defenses

Diplomacy Rider.description:
After an agenda is revealed:

You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, choose 1 system that contains a planet you control. Each other player places a command token from their reinforcements in that system.
Diplomacy Rider.name: Diplomacy Rider

Direct Hit.description:
After another player's ship uses SUSTAIN DAMAGE to cancel a hit produced by your units or abilities:

Destroy that ship.
Direct Hit.name: Direct Hit

Disable.description:
At the start of an invasion in a system that contains 1 or more of your opponents' PDS units:

Your opponents' PDS units lose PLANETARY SHIELD and SPACE CANNON during this invasion.
Disable.name: Disable

Distinguished Councilor.description:
After you cast votes on an outcome of an agenda:

Cast 5 additional votes for that outcome.
Distinguished Councilor.name: Distinguished Councilor

Economic Initiative.description: ACTION: Ready each cultural planet you control.
Economic Initiative.name: Economic Initiative

Emergency Repairs.description:
At the start or end of a combat round:

Repair all of your units that have SUSTAIN DAMAGE in the active system.
Emergency Repairs.name: Emergency Repairs

Experimental Battlestation.description:
After another player moves ships into a system during a tactical action:

Choose 1 of your space docks that is either in or adjacent to that system. That space dock uses SPACE CANNON 5 (x3) against ships in the active system.
Experimental Battlestation.name: Experimental Battlestation

Fighter Prototype.description:
At the start of the first round of a space combat:

Apply +2 to the result of each of your fighters' combat rolls during this combat round.
Fighter Prototype.name: Fighter Prototype

Fire Team.description:
After your ground forces make combat rolls during a round of ground combat:

Reroll any number of your dice.
Fire Team.name: Fire Team

Flank Speed.description:
After you activate a system:

Apply +1 to the move value of each of your ships during this tactical action.
Flank Speed.name: Flank Speed

Focused Research.description: ACTION: Spend 4 trade goods to research 1 technology.
Focused Research.name: Focused Research

Frontline Deployment.description: ACTION: Place 3 infantry from your reinforcements on 1 planet you control.
Frontline Deployment.name: Frontline Deployment

Ghost Ship.description: ACTION: Place 1 destroyer from your reinforcements in a non-home system that contains a wormhole and does not contain other players' ships.
Ghost Ship.name: Ghost Ship

Imperial Rider.description:
After an agenda is revealed:

You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, gain 1 victory point.
Imperial Rider.name: Imperial Rider

In The Silence Of Space.description:
After you activate a system:

Choose 1 system. During this tactical action, your ships in the chosen system can move through systems that contain other players' ships.
In The Silence Of Space.name: In The Silence Of Space

Industrial Initiative.description: ACTION: Gain 1 trade good for each industrial planet you control.
Industrial Initiative.name: Industrial Initiative

Infiltrate.description:
When you gain control of a planet:

Replace each PDS and space dock that is on that planet with a matching unit from your reinforcements.
Infiltrate.name: Infiltrate

Insubordination.description: ACTION: Remove 1 token from another player's tactic pool and return it to their reinforcements.
Insubordination.name: Insubordination

Intercept.description:
After your opponent declares a retreat during a space combat:

Your opponent cannot retreat during this round of space combat.
Intercept.name: Intercept

Leadership Rider.description:
After an agenda is revealed:

You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, gain 3 command tokens.
Leadership Rider.name: Leadership Rider

Lost Star Chart.description:
After you activate a system:

During this tactical action, systems that contain alpha and beta wormholes are adjacent to each other.
Lost Star Chart.name: Lost Star Chart

Lucky Shot.description: ACTION: Destroy 1 dreadnought, cruiser, or destroyer in a system that contains a planet you control.
Lucky Shot.name: Lucky Shot

Maneuvering Jets.description:
Before you assign hits produced by another player's SPACE CANNON roll:

Cancel 1 hit.
Maneuvering Jets.name: Maneuvering Jets

Mining Initiative.description: ACTION: Gain trade goods equal to the resource value of 1 planet you control.
Mining Initiative.name: Mining Initiative

Morale Boost.description:
At the start of a combat round:

Apply +1 to the result of each of your unit's combat rolls during this combat round.
Morale Boost.name: Morale Boost

Parley.description:
After another player commits units to land on a planet you control:

Return the committed units to the space area.
Parley.name: Parley

Plague.description: ACTION: Choose 1 planet that is controlled by another player. Roll 1 die for each infantry on that planet. For each result of 6 or greater, destroy 1 of those units.
Plague.name: Plague

Political Stability.description:
When you would return your strategy card(s) during the status phase:

Do not return your strategy card(s). You do not choose strategy cards during the next strategy phase.
Political Stability.name: Political Stability

Politics Rider.description:
After an agenda is revealed:

You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, draw 3 action cards and gain the speaker token.
Politics Rider.name: Politics Rider

Public Disgrace.description:
When another player chooses a strategy card during the strategy phase:

That player must choose a different strategy card instead, if able.
Public Disgrace.name: Public Disgrace

Reactor Meltdown.description: ACTION: Destroy 1 space dock in a non-home system.
Reactor Meltdown.name: Reactor Meltdown

Reparations.description:
After another player gains control of a planet you control:

Exhaust 1 planet that player controls and ready 1 planet you control.
Reparations.name: Reparations

Rise of a Messiah.description: ACTION: Place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on each planet you control.
Rise of a Messiah.name: Rise of a Messiah

Sabotage.description:
When another player plays an action card other than "Sabotage":

Cancel that action card.
Sabotage.name: Sabotage

Salvage.description:
After you win a space combat:

Your opponent gives you all of their commodities.
Salvage.name: Salvage

Shields Holding.description:
Before you assign hits to your ships during a space combat:

Cancel up to 2 hits.
Shields Holding.name: Shields Holding

Signal Jamming.description: ACTION: Chose 1 non-home system that contains or is adjacent to 1 of your ships. Place a command token from another player's reinforcements in that system.
Signal Jamming.name: Signal Jamming

Skilled Retreat.description:
At the start of a combat round:

Move all of your ships from the active system into an adjacent system that does not contain another player's ships; the space combat ends in a draw. Then, place a command token from your reinforcements in that system.
Skilled Retreat.name: Skilled Retreat

Spy.description: ACTION: Choose 1 player. That player gives you 1 random action card from their hand.
Spy.name: Spy

Summit.description:
At the start of the strategy phase:

Gain 2 command tokens.
Summit.name: Summit

Tactical Bombardment.description: ACTION: Choose 1 system that contains 1 or more of your units that have BOMBARDMENT. Exhaust each planet controlled by other players in that system.
Tactical Bombardment.name: Tactical Bombardment

Technology Rider.description:
After an agenda is revealed:

You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, research 1 technology.
Technology Rider.name: Technology Rider

Trade Rider.description:
After an agenda is revealed:

You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, gain 5 trade goods.
Trade Rider.name: Trade Rider

Unexpected Action.description: ACTION: Remove 1 of your command tokens from the game board and return it to your reinforcements.
Unexpected Action.name: Unexpected Action

Unstable Planet.description: ACTION: Choose 1 hazardous planet. Exhaust that planet and destroy up to 3 infantry on it.
Unstable Planet.name: Unstable Planet

Upgrade.description:
After you activate a system that contains 1 or more of your ships:

Replace one of your cruisers in that system with one of your dreadnoughts from your reinforcements.
Upgrade.name: Upgrade

Uprising.description: ACTION: Exhaust 1 non-home planet controlled by another player. Then gain trade goods equal to its resource value.
Uprising.name: Uprising

Veto.description:
When an agenda is revealed:

Discard that agenda and reveal 1 agenda from the top of the deck. Players vote on this agenda instead.
Veto.name: Veto

War Effort.description: ACTION: Place 1 cruiser from your reinforcements in a system that contains 1 or more of your ships.
War Effort.name: War Effort

Warfare Rider.description:
After an agenda is revealed:

You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, place 1 dreadnought from your reinforcements in a system that contains 1 or more of your ships.
Warfare Rider.name: Warfare Rider

Blitz.description:
At the start of an invasion:

Each of your non-fighter ships in the active system that does not have BOMBARDMENT gains BOMBARDMENT 6 until the end of the invasion.
Blitz.name: Blitz

Counterstroke.description:
After another player activates a system that contains 1 of your command tokens:

Return that command token to your tactic pool.
Counterstroke.name: Counterstroke

Fighter Conscription.description: ACTION: Place 1 fighter from your reinforcements into each system that contains 1 or more of your space docks or ships that have a capacity value; they cannot be placed in systems that contain other players' ships.
Fighter Conscription.name: Fighter Conscription

Forward Supply Base.description:
After another player activates a system that contains your units:

Gain 3 trade goods. Then, choose another player to gain 1 trade good.
Forward Supply Base.name: Forward Supply Base

Ghost Squad.description:
After a player commits units to land on a planet you control:

Move any number of ground forces from any planet you control in the active system to any other planet you control in the active system.
Ghost Squad.name: Ghost Squad

Hack Election.description:
After an agenda is revealed:

During this agenda, voting begins with the player to the right of the speaker and continues counterclockwise.
Hack Election.name: Hack Election

omegas.description:
After an agenda is revealed:

During this agenda, you vote last.

Harness Energy.description:
After you activate an anomaly:

Replenish your commodities.
Harness Energy.name: Harness Energy

Impersonation.description: ACTION: Spend 3 influence to draw 1 secret objective.
Impersonation.name: Impersonation

Insider Information.description:
After an agenda is revealed:

Look at the top card of the agenda deck.
Insider Information.name: Insider Information

omegas.description:
After an agenda is revealed:

Look at the top 3 cards of the agenda deck.

Master Plan.description:
After you perform an action:

Perform an additional action.
Master Plan.name: Master Plan

Plagiarize.description: ACTION: Spend 5 influence and choose a non-faction technology owned by one of your neighbors; gain that technology.
Plagiarize.name: Plagiarize

Rally.description:
After you activate a system that contains another player's ships:

Place 2 command tokens from your reinforcements in your fleet pool.
Rally.name: Rally

Reflective Shielding.description:
When one of your ships uses SUSTAIN DAMAGE during combat:

Produce 2 hits against your opponent's ships in the active system.
Reflective Shielding.name: Reflective Shielding

Sanction.description:
After an agenda is revealed:

You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, each player that voted for that outcome returns 1 command token from their fleet supply to their reinforcements.
Sanction.name: Sanction

Scramble Frequency.description:
After another player makes a BOMBARDMENT, SPACE CANNON, or ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE roll:

That player rerolls all of their dice.
Scramble Frequency.name: Scramble Frequency

Solar Flare.description:
After you activate a system:

During the "Movement" step of this tactical action, other players cannot use SPACE CANNON against your ships.
Solar Flare.name: Solar Flare

War Machine.description:
When 1 or more of your units use PRODUCTION:

Apply +4 to the total PRODUCTION value of those units and reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 1.
War Machine.name: War Machine

Archaeological Expedition.description: ACTION: Reveal the top 3 cards of an exploration deck that matches a planet you control; gain any relic fragments that you reveal and discard the rest.
Archaeological Expedition.name: Archaeological Expedition

Confounding Legal Text.description:
When another player is elected as the outcome of an agenda:

You are the elected player instead.
Confounding Legal Text.name: Confounding Legal Text

Coup d'Etat.description:
When another player would perform a strategic action:

End that player's trun; that strategic action is not resolved and the strategy card is not exhausted.
Coup d'Etat.name: Coup d'Etat

Deadly Plot.description:
During the agenda phase, when an outcome would be resolved:

If you voted for or predicted another outcome, discard the agenda instead; the agenda is resolved with no effect and it is not replaced.

Then, exhaust all of your planets.
Deadly Plot.name: Deadly Plot

Decoy Operation.description:
After another player activates a system that contains 1 or more of your structures:

Remove up to 2 of your ground forces from the game board and place them on a planet you control in the active system.
Decoy Operation.name: Decoy Operation

Diplomatic Pressure.description:
When an agenda is revealed:

Choose another player; that player must give you 1 promissory note from their hand.
Diplomatic Pressure.name: Diplomatic Pressure

Divert Funding.description:
ACTION: Return a non-unit upgrade, non-faction technology that you own to your technology deck.

Then, research another technology.
Divert Funding.name: Divert Funding

Exploration Probe.description: ACTION: Explore a frontier token that is in or adjacent to a system that contains 1 or more of your ships.
Exploration Probe.name: Exploration Probe

Manipulate Investments.description:
At the start of the strategy phase:

Place a total of 5 trade goods from the supply on strategy cards of your choice; you must place these tokens on at least 3 different cards.
Manipulate Investments.name: Manipulate Investments

Nav Suite.description:
After you activate a system:

During the "Movement" step of this tactical action, ignore the effect of anomalies.
Nav Suite.name: Nav Suite

Refit Troops.description: ACTION: Choose 1 or 2 of your infantry on the game board; replace each of those infantry with mechs.
Refit Troops.name: Refit Troops

Reveal Prototype.description:
At the start of a combat:

Spend 4 resources to research a unit upgrade technology of the same type as 1 of your units that is participating in this combat.
Reveal Prototype.name: Reveal Prototype

Reverse Engineer.description:
After another player discards an action card that has a component action:

Take that action card from the discard pile.
Reverse Engineer.name: Reverse Engineer

Rout.description:
At the start of the "Announce Retreats" step of space combat, if you are the defender:

Your opponent must announce a retreat, if able.
Rout.name: Rout

Scuttle.description: ACTION: Choose 1 or 2 of your non-fighter ships on the game board and return them to your reinforcements; gain trade goods equal to the combined cost of those ships.
Scuttle.name: Scuttle

Seize Artifact.description: ACTION: Choose 1 of your neighbors that has 1 or more relic fragments. That player must give you 1 relic fragment of your choice.
Seize Artifact.name: Seize Artifact

Waylay.description:
Before you roll dice for ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE:

Hits from this roll are produced against all ships (not just fighters).
Waylay.name: Waylay

Black Market Dealings.description:
When you are negotiating a transaction:

You and the other player can include relics, action cards, and unscored secret objectives as part of the transaction. This card cannot be cancelled.
Black Market Dealings.name: Black Market Dealings

Brilliance.description: ACTION: Ready 1 of your planets that has a technology speciality or choose 1 player to gain their breakthrough.
Brilliance.name: Brilliance

Crash Landing.description:
When your last ship in the active system is destroyed:

Place 1 of your ground forces from the space area of the active system onto a planet in that system other than Mecatol Rex; if the planet contains other players' units, place your ground force into coexistence.
Crash Landing.name: Crash Landing

Crisis.description:
At the end of any player's turn, if there are at least 2 players who have not passed:

Skip the next player's turn.
Crisis.name: Crisis

Exchange Program.description: ACTION: Choose another player. You and the planet may agree to place 1 infantry from each of your reinforcements into coexistence on a planet the other player controls that contains their ground forces; if no agreement is reached, you each discard 1 token from your fleet pool.
Exchange Program.name: Exchange Program

Extreme Duress.description:
At the start of another player's turn, if they have a readied strategy card:

If that player's next action is not a strategic action, they discard all of their action cards, give you all of their trade goods, and show you all of their secret objectives.
Extreme Duress.name: Extreme Duress

Lie in Wait.description:
After 2 of your neighbors resolve a transaction:

Look at each of those players' hands of action cards, then choose and take 1 action card from each.
Lie in Wait.name: Lie in Wait

Mercenary Contract.description: ACTION: Spend 2 trade goods to place 2 neutral infantry on any non-home planet that contains no units; if that planet was owned by another player, they return its planet card to the planet card deck.
Mercenary Contract.name: Mercenary Contract

Overrule.description: ACTION: Perform the primary ability of a readied or unchosen strategy card.
Overrule.name: Overrule

Pirate Contract.description: ACTION: Place 1 neutral destroyer in a non-home system that contains no non-neutral ships.
Pirate Contract.name: Pirate Contract

Pirate Fleet.description: ACTION: Spend 3 resources to place 1 neutral carrier, 1 neutral cruiser, 1 neutral destroyer, and 2 neutral fighters in a non-home system that contains no non-neutral ships.
Pirate Fleet.name: Pirate Fleet

Puppets on a String.description:
At the end of any player's turn, if you have passed:

Perform 1 action.
Puppets on a String.name: Puppets on a String

Rescue.description:
After another player moves ships into a system that contains your ships:

You may move 1 of your ships into the active system from any system that does not contain one of your command tokens.
Rescue.name: Rescue

Strategize.description: ACTION: Perform the secondary ability of any readied or unchosen strategy card.
Strategize.name: Strategize

Atomize.description:
When your flagship is destroyed:

Purge your flagship and destroy all other units in its system.
Atomize.name: Atomize

Cloak.description:
After you activate a system:

Your ships can move through systems that contain other players' ships during this action, and SPACE CANNON cannot be used against them.
Cloak.name: Cloak

Coerce.description: ACTION: Choose a player. That player must give you 1 of their abilities.
Coerce.name: Coerce

Command.description:
After you activate a system:

Apply +1 to the move value of each of your ships during this tactical action. Additionally, your ships may move through and into asteroid fields during this movement.
Command.name: Command

Converge.description:
Before you roll dice for SPACE CANNON:

Your hits must be applied to non-fighter ships during SPACE CANNON OFFENSE, or mechs during SPACE CANNON DEFENSE, if able.
Converge.name: Converge

Divinity.description:
When 1 of your units would be destroyed:

It is not destroyed instead.
Divinity.name: Divinity

Engineer.description:
When you draw cards for a splice that you initiated:

Add 2 additional cards to the splice; after you choose your card, choose and discard 2 of the spliced cards before passing them to the next player.
Engineer.name: Engineer

Entangle.description:
After you activate a system:

All systems that contain alpha wormholes, beta wormholes, gamma wormholes, and gravity rifts are adjacent during this movement.
Entangle.name: Entangle

Evolve.description: ACTION: Draw 1 card from any splice deck.
Evolve.name: Evolve

Feint.description:
When you announce a retreat:

Your units immediately retreat to an eligible system; do not place a command token in that system.
Feint.name: Feint

Flux.description: ACTION: Either remove any player's command token from the board, or place a command token from any player's reinforcements in a system that contains or is adjacent to one of your ships.
Flux.name: Flux

Genophage.description: ACTION: Discard 1 of your neighbors' genomes.
Genophage.name: Genophage

Hardlight.description:
Before hits are assigned to your units:

Cancel up to 2 hits.
Hardlight.name: Hardlight

Helix.description: ACTION: Initiate a splice of any type, including all players.
Helix.name: Helix

Ignis.description: ACTION: Place a command token from your tactic pool in any non-home system; choose and destroy 1 unit in that system.
Ignis.name: Ignis

Irradiate.description: ACTION: Choose 1 unit type other than flagship; reveal cards from the unit upgrade deck until you reveal a card of that type, if able. Then, gain that card and shuffle the rest back into the unit upgrade deck.
Irradiate.name: Irradiate

Lash.description:
When 1 of your units is destroyed:

Destroy a unit in its system that has an equal or lower cost.
Lash.name: Lash

Locust.description: ACTION: Choose 1 infantry in a system adjacent to your units and roll 1 die. On a result of 3 or higher, destroy that infantry and choose an infantry in the same or an adjacent system to repeat this roll; for each new roll, choose an infantry owned by a different player than the previous infantry, if able.
Locust.name: Locust

Magnificence.description: ACTION: Move all units from the space area of any system into an adjacent system that contains a different player's ships. Space combat is resolved in that system; neither player can retreat or resolve abilities that would move their ships.
Magnificence.name: Magnificence

Manifest.description: ACTION: Resolve the PRODUCTION ability of 1 of your units; reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 3.
Manifest.name: Manifest

Manipulate.description:
After cards are drawn for a splice that you are not participating in:

Take the cards and choose which card each participating player will take.
Manipulate.name: Manipulate

Meddle.description:
When any die is rolled:

Add or subtract 1 from its result.
Meddle.name: Meddle

Meld.description:
When a die is rolled by any player:

Roll two dice instead, and add the results together (max 10).
Meld.name: Meld

Meteor.description:
When you would remove ground forces due to insufficient capacity:

Commit those ground forces to a planet in that system instead; resolve an invasion on that planet using only those ground forces.
Meteor.name: Meteor

Mutate.description: ACTION: Discard 1 of your abilities, then draw 1 ability.
Mutate.name: Mutate

Pax.description:
After another player commits units to land on a planet you control:

Return the committed units to the space area; choose 1 of them to destroy.
Pax.name: Pax

Reflect.description: ACTION: For each trade good you have, either gain 1 commodity or convert 1 of your commodities to a trade good.
Reflect.name: Reflect

Reverse.description:
When a splice begins:

Reverse the order the spliced cards are passed.
Reverse.name: Reverse

Rise.description: ACTION: Either place 1 infantry on each planet you control or place 1 fighter in each system that contains your ships or space docks and no other players' ships.
Rise.name: Rise

Scarab.description: ACTION: Choose a spliced card you own; gain 2 trade goods for each card you own with a faction origin that matches that card.
Scarab.name: Scarab

Shatter.description:
When another player exhausts a genome or plays an action card other than "Shatter":

That genome is exhausted without effect, or that action card is canceled.
Shatter.name: Shatter

Spark.description:
After another player's unit uses SUSTAIN DAMAGE to cancel a hit produced by your units or abilities:

Destroy that unit.
Spark.name: Spark

Starflare.description: ACTION: Choose a supernova; each player destroys 3 of their units in that supernova and each adjacent system.
Starflare.name: Starflare

Stasis.description:
At the start of another player's turn:

Immediately end that player's turn.
Stasis.name: Stasis

Tartarus.description:
At the start of the strategy phase:

Choose a strategy card; that card cannot be picked unless there is no other option.
Tartarus.name: Tartarus

Thieve.description:
When a splice ends, if you did not participate:

Take all of the remaining spliced cards.
Thieve.name: Thieve

Timestop.description:
When a player activates a system that contains your units:

Immediately perform an action, during which you are the active player.
Timestop.name: Timestop

Transpose.description: ACTION: Give 1 of your abilities to one of your neighbors, then take 1 of their abilities.
Transpose.name: Transpose

Trine.description:
During the "Space Cannon Offense" step of a tactical action:

Your units up to 2 systems away can use their SPACE CANNON abilities against ships in the active system.
Trine.name: Trine

Twinning.description:
After another player resolves the component action of an action card:

Immediately resolve that action card as if you played it.
Twinning.name: Twinning

Unravel.description: ACTION: Choose and purge a relic. If the relic belonged to another player, that player gains 1 victory point; if it belonged to you, put The Fracture into play and place 1 additional ingress token in a system that contains your units.
Unravel.name: Unravel

Vault.description:
After you activate a system:

You may ignore the effects of anomalies during this movement.
Vault.name: Vault

Free Trade Initiative.description: ACTION: For each planet trait, if you control a planet of that trait, gain 2 commodities or convert 2 of your commodities to trade goods.
Free Trade Initiative.name: Free Trade Initiative

Micrometeoroid Storm.description: ACTION: Choose 1 system that contains another player's ships. Roll 1 die for each fighter in that system. For each result of 6 or greater, destroy 1 of those units.
Micrometeoroid Storm.name: Micrometeoroid Storm

Neural Hammer.description: ACTION: Choose 1 player with the most victory points. Look at up to 1 of their unscored secret objectives, at random.
Neural Hammer.name: Neural Hammer

Personnel Writ.description: ACTION: Ready your agent or spend 1 command token from your strategy pool to unlock your commander.
Personnel Writ.name: Personnel Writ

Planetary Rigs.description: ACTION: Choose 1 non-home planet you control other than Mecatol Rex. Reveal cards from that planet's corresponding exploration deck until you reveal an attachment; attach that attachment to that planet and discard the rest.
Planetary Rigs.name: Planetary Rigs

Professional Archaeologists.description: ACTION: For each exploration deck, look at the top card of that deck; if that card is a relic fragment, reveal and gain that card, otherwise discard that card and gain 1 commodity.
Professional Archaeologists.name: Professional Archaeologists

Remnant Collection.description: ACTION: Purge any number of your relic fragments to draw an equal number of action cards.
Remnant Collection.name: Remnant Collection

Secured Trove.description: ACTION: Purge any 2 of your relic fragments to gain 1 relic.
Secured Trove.name: Secured Trove

Airo Shir Aur.description:
ACTION: Move all units in the space area of any system to an adjacent system that contains a different player's ships. Space Combat is resolved in that system; neither player can retreat or resolve abilities that would move their ships

Then, purge this card
Airo Shir Aur.name: Airo Shir Aur

Claire Gibson.description:
At the start of a ground combat on a planet you control:

You may place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on that planet.
Claire Gibson.name: Claire Gibson
Claire Gibson.unlock: Control planets that have a combined total of at least 12 resources.

Dart and Tai.description:
After you gain control of a planet that was controlled by another player:

You may explore that planet.
Dart and Tai.name: Dart and Tai

Doctor Sucaban.description:
When a player spends resources to research:

You may exhaust this card to allow that player to remove any number of their infantry from the game board. For each unit removed, reduce the resources spent by 1.
Doctor Sucaban.name: Doctor Sucaban

Emissary Taivra.description:
After a player activates a system that contains a non-delta wormhole:

You may exhaust this card; if you do, that system is adjacent to all other systems that contain a wormhole during this tactical action.
Emissary Taivra.name: Emissary Taivra

Evelyn Delouis.description:
At the start of a ground combat round:

You may exhaust this card to choose 1 ground force in the active system; that ground force rolls 1 additional die during that combat round.
Evelyn Delouis.name: Evelyn Delouis

Garv and Gunn.description:
At the end of a player's turn:

You may exhaust this card to allow that player to explore 1 of their planets.
Garv and Gunn.name: Garv and Gunn

Hesh and Prit.description:
ACTION: Gain 1 relic and perform the secondary ability of up to 2 readied or unchosen strategy cards; during this action, spend command tokens from your reinforcements instead of your strategy pool.

Then, purge this card.
Hesh and Prit.name: Hesh and Prit

Il Na Viroset.description: During your tactical actions, you can activate systems that contain your command tokens. If you do, return both command tokens to your reinforcements and end your turn.
Il Na Viroset.name: Il Na Viroset
Il Na Viroset.unlock: Have 2 other factions' command tokens in your fleet pool.

It Feeds on Carrion.description:
ACTION: Each other player rolls a die for each of their non-fighter ships that are in or adjacent to a system that contains a dimensional tear; on a 1-3, capture that unit. If this causes a player's ground forces or fighters to be removed, also capture those units

Then, purge this card
It Feeds on Carrion.name: It Feeds on Carrion

Jace X 4th Air Legion.description:
ACTION: Remove each of your command tokens from the game board and return them to your reinforcements.

Then, purge this card.
Jace X 4th Air Legion.name: Jace X. 4th Air Legion

Jae Mir Kan.description:
When you would spend a command token during the secondary ability of a strategic action:

You may exhaust this card to remove 1 of the active player's command tokens from the board and use it instead.
Jae Mir Kan.name: Jae Mir Kan

Rin The Master's Legacy.description:
ACTION: For each non-unit upgrade technology you own, you may replace that technology with any technology of the same color from the deck.

Then, purge this card.
Rin The Master's Legacy.name: Rin, The Master's Legacy

Riftwalker Meian.description:
ACTION: Swap the positions of any 2 systems that contain wormholes or your units, other than the Creuss system and the Wormhole Nexus.

Then, purge this card
Riftwalker Meian.name: Riftwalker Meian

Sai Seravus.description:
After your ships move:

For each ship that has a capacity value and moved through 1 or more wormholes, you may place 1 fighter from your reinforcements with that ship if you have unused capacity in the active system.
Sai Seravus.name: Sai Seravus
Sai Seravus.unlock: Have units in 3 systems that contain alpha or beta wormholes.

Ta Zern.description:
After you roll dice for a unit ability:

You may reroll any of those dice.
Ta Zern.name: Ta Zern

That Which Molds Flesh.description:
When you produce fighter or infantry units:

Up to 2 of those units do not count against your PRODUCTION limit.
That Which Molds Flesh.name: That Which Molds Flesh

The Stillness of Stars.description:
After another player replenishes commodities:

You may exhaust this card to convert their commodities to trade goods and capture 1 unit from their reinforcements that has a cost equal to or lower than their commodity value.
The Stillness of Stars.name: The Stillness of Stars

Fires of the Gashlai.description:
ACTION: Remove 1 token from the Muaat player's fleet pool and return it to their reinforcements. Then, gain your war sun unit upgrade technology card.

Then, return this card to the Muaat player.
Fires of the Gashlai.name: Fires of the Gashlai

Lazax Gate Folding.description:
During your tactical actions, if you do not control Mecatol Rex, treat its systems as if it has both an α and β wormhole.

ACTION: If you control Mecatol Rex, exhaust this card to place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on Mecatol Rex.
Lazax Gate Folding.name: Lazax Gate Folding

Mageon Implants.description: ACTION: Exhaust this card to look at another player's hand of action cards. Choose 1 of those cards and add it to your hand.
Mageon Implants.name: Mageon Implants

Orbital Drop.description: ACTION: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to place 2 infantry from your reinforcements on 1 planet you control.
Orbital Drop.name: Orbital Drop

Production Biomes.description: ACTION: Exhaust this card and spend 1 token from your strategy pool to gain 4 trade goods and choose 1 other player; that player gains 2 trade goods.
Production Biomes.name: Production Biomes

Promise of Protection.description:
ACTION: Place this card face-up in your play area.

While this card is in your play area, the Mentak player cannot use their PILLAGE faction ability against you.

If you activate a system that contains 1 or more of the Mentak player's units, return this card to the Mentak player.
Promise of Protection.name: Promise of Protection

Stall Tactics.description: ACTION: Discard 1 action card from your hand.
Stall Tactics.name: Stall Tactics

Star Forge.description: ACTION: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to place either 2 fighters or 1 destroyer from your reinforcements in a system that contains 1 or more of your war suns.
Star Forge.name: Star Forge

Stymie.description:
ACTION: Place this card face up in your play area.

While this card is in your play area, the Arborec player cannot produce units in or adjacent to non-home systems that contain 1 or more of your units.

If you activate a system that contains 1 or more of the Arborec player's units, return this card to the Arborec player.
Stymie.name: Stymie

The Inferno.description: ACTION: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to place 1 cruiser in this unit's system.
The Inferno.name: The Inferno

Trade Convoys.description:
ACTION: Place this card face-up in your play area.

While this card is in your play area, you may negotiate transactions with players who are not your neighbor.

If you activate a system that contains 1 or more of the Hacan player's units, return this card to the Hacan player.
Trade Convoys.name: Trade Convoys

X-89 Bacterial Weapon.description: ACTION: Exhaust this card and choose 1 planet in a system that contains 1 or more of your ships that have BOMBARDMENT; destroy all infantry on that planet.
X-89 Bacterial Weapon.name: X-89 Bacterial Weapon

Black Market Forgery.description:
ACTION: Purge 2 of your relic fragments of the same type to gain 1 relic.

Then return this card to the Naaz-Rokha player.
Black Market Forgery.name: Black Market Forgery

Blood Pact.description:
ACTION: Place this card face up in your play area.

When you and the Empyrean player cast votes for the same outcome, cast 4 additional votes for that outcome.

If you activate a system that contains 1 or more of the Empyrean player's units, return this card to the Empyrean player.
Blood Pact.name: Blood Pact

Dark Pact.description:
ACTION: Place this card face up in your play area.

When you give a number of commodities to the Empyrean player equal to your maximum commodity value, you each gain 1 trade good.

If you activate a system that contains 1 or more of the Empyrean player's units, return this card to the Empyrean player.
Dark Pact.name: Dark Pact

Enigmatic Device.description: ACTION: You may spend 6 resources and purge this card to research 1 technology.
Enigmatic Device.name: Enigmatic Device

Fabrication.description: ACTION: Either purge 2 of your relic fragments of the same type to gain 1 relic; or purge 1 of your relic fragments to gain 1 command token.
Fabrication.name: Fabrication

Gain Relic.description: ACTION: Purge 3 of your relic fragments of the same type to gain 1 Relic.
Gain Relic.name: Gain Relic

Sling Relay.description: ACTION: Exhaust this card to produce 1 ship in any system that contains 1 of your space docks.
Sling Relay.name: Sling Relay

Terraform.description:
ACTION: Attach this card to a non-home planet you control other than Mecatol Rex.

Its resource and influence values are each increased by 1 and it is treated as having all 3 planet traits (Cultural, Hazardous, and Industrial).
Terraform.name: Terraform

Vortex.description: ACTION: Exhaust this card to choose another player's non-structure unit in a system that is adjacent to 1 or more of your space docks. Capture 1 unit of that type from that player's reinforcements.
Vortex.name: Vortex

Avernus.description: ACTION: Exhaust this card to use the Embers of Muaat's STAR FORGE faction ability without spending a command token.
Avernus.name: Avernus

Conventions of War Abandoned.description: ACTION: Exhaust X-89 BACTERIAL WEAPON to choose 1 planet in a system that contains 1 of your units that has BOMBARDMENT; purge its planet card and all attachments or legendary planet ability cards associated with it.
Conventions of War Abandoned.name: Conventions of War Abandoned

Executive Order.description: ACTION: Reveal the top or bottom card of the agenda deck and vote on it, being speaker. You may use trade goods to vote.
Executive Order.name: Executive Order

Nanomachines.description:
ACTION: Exhaust this card to place 1 PDS on a planet you control.

ACTION: Exhaust this card to repair all of your damaged units.

ACTION: Exhaust this card and discard 1 action card to draw 1 action card.
Nanomachines.name: Nanomachines

Mercenaries for Hire.description: ACTION: Spend 3 trade goods to gain the top card of the mercenary deck and place it in your play area.
Mercenaries for Hire.name: Mercenaries for Hire

Puppets of the Blade.description:
If you have at least 1 plot card in your play area, gain the following ability:

ACTION: Purge The Firmament's faction sheet, leaders, planet cards, and promissory note. Then, gain all of the faction components for The Obsidian.
Puppets of the Blade.name: Puppets of the Blade

Sever.description:
ACTION: Place this card faceup in your play area and place the sever token in a system that contains your units; wormholes in that system have no effect during movement.

Remove the sever token and return this card to the Rebellion player at the end of the status phase.
Sever.name: Sever

Share Knowledge.description:
ACTION: Place this card faceup in your play area and gain 1 non-faction, non-unit upgrade technology that the Deepwrought player owns; place that technology on this card.

Return that technology to the deck and this card to the Deepwrought player at the end of the status phase.
Share Knowledge.name: Share Knowledge

Stellar Atomics.description: ACTION: Discard your control token from the Stellar Atomics card to destroy all ground forces and structures on any non-home planet.
Stellar Atomics.name: Stellar Atomics

Wormhole Generator.description: ACTION: Exhaust this card to place or move a Creuss wormhole token into either a system that contains a planet you control or a non-home system that does not contain another player's ships.
Wormhole Generator.name: Wormhole Generator

Age of Exploration.description: ACTION: Exhaust DARK ENERGY TAP and choose a non-home edge system that contains your ships to roll 1 die. On a result of 1-4, draw a random unused red tile; on a result of 5-10, draw a random unused blue tile. Place that tile adjacent to the chosen system so that it is touching at least 2 non-home systems. Place a frontier token in the system if it does not contain any planets.
Age of Exploration.name: Age of Exploration

Total War.description: ACTION: Discard 10 commodities from planets in your home system to gain 1 victory point.
Total War.name: Total War

Algorithmic Replication.description: Choose 1 action card from the action card discard pile and add it to your hand. Then, purge this card.
Algorithmic Replication.name: Algorithmic Replication

Emergency Deployment.description: Exhaust this card to place or move 1 of your space docks onto a planet you control.
Emergency Deployment.name: Emergency Deployment

Impressment Programs.description: Exhaust this card and 1 planet you control to explore that planet.
Impressment Programs.name: Impressment Programs

Gledge Base.description:
ACTION: Attach this card to a non-home planet you control.

This planet's resource value is increased by 2.
Gledge Base.name: Gledge Base

Read the Fates.description:
Place this face up in your play area.

While this card is in your play area, you may look at the public objective card on the Ilyxum player's faction sheet.

If you activate a system that contains 1 or more of the Ilyxum player's units, return this card to the Ilyxum player.
Read the Fates.name: Read the Fates

Seeker Drones.description: Exhaust this card to choose 1 of your neighbors that has 1 or more relic fragments. That player gains 2 trade goods and must give you 1 of those relic fragments of your choice.
Seeker Drones.name: Seeker Drones

Blessing of the Queens.description:
Place this card face up in your play area and remove 1 of your command tokens from the game board.

At the start of the status phase, return this card to the Kortali player.
Blessing of the Queens.name: Blessing of the Queens

Gift of Insight.description:
Place this card face up in your play area.

While this card is in your play area, once per turn, after you roll a die, you may reroll that die.

If you activate a system that contains 1 or more of the Myko-Mentori player's units, return this card to the Myko-Mentori player.
Gift of Insight.name: Gift of Insight

Incite Revolution.description:
Place this card face up in your play area to choose and exhaust 1 planet you control. Then, ready 1 non-home planet you control other than Mecatol Rex.

At the start of the status phase, return this card to the Olradin player.
Incite Revolution.name: Incite Revolution

Star Chart.description: Purge 2 of your Star Charts to draw 1 system tile with a blue-colored back at random; place that tile at the edge of the game board, adjacent to at least 2 other systems.
Star Chart.name: Star Chart

event.objective: Learn the Secrets of the Cosmos
